captions:
Let me just squeeze in a quick start before the chaos kicks off.
Isla grabs a steady moment at her kitchen table before the workday truly begins.

There's absolutely no point in trying to race against the clock today.
She glances at the passing scenery, trying to outrun her mounting daily checklist.

I just need to wrap this up before I log back in.
A sudden buzz from her phone reminds her that time is quickly running out.

Anti-Knight today — knight moves block matching numbers.
Anti-Knight changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.

There we go. That connection actually holds up under scrutiny.
The calendar notification flashes on her screen, signaling it is time to wrap up.

Perfect. Time to leave it there and get back to the grind.
With the final proof settled, she closes the book and refocuses on her work.
